description: Customisable settings for the visitor-kiosk app

name.description: Application name sent with PlaceOS API requests. Falls back to `short_name`

short_name.description: Prefix for console log messages. Also used as the API application name when `name` is not set

default_route.description: Route to redirect to after the application has initialised. Defaults to `welcome`

inactivity_timeout_secs.description: Number of seconds with no touch, click or key press before the kiosk returns to the welcome page. The welcome and setup pages stay open. Set to `0` to turn off the reset. Defaults to `120`

logo_light.description: URL of the logo to display when the application is using a light theme

logo_dark.description: URL of the logo to display when the application is using a dark theme

welcome_background.description: URL of the background image displayed on the welcome, check-in and registration pages

welcome_message.description: HTML message displayed on the welcome page. Falls back to a translated default message when unset

hide_building_image.description: Whether to hide the building image panel on the welcome, check-in and registration pages

hide_explore.description: Whether to hide the explore (building map) button on the welcome page

allow_self_registration.description: Whether walk-up visitors can register themselves. Shows the register button on the welcome page

allow_registration_time_options.description: Whether the self-registration form shows time options (all-day checkbox and visit duration field)

allow_pass_number.description: Whether to show a visitor pass number field on the registration and check-in details forms

allow_user_photo.description: Whether visitors are asked to take a photo of themselves during check-in

allow_printing_label.description: Whether a visitor badge label can be printed after check-in. Defaults to `true`

allow_beverages.description: Whether visitors can select beverage (catering) preferences after checking in. Only applies to visitors with a linked event or when `standalone_visitor_location` is set

visitor_label_size.description: Dimensions of the printed visitor badge label

width.description: Width of the printed label in `em`, relative to the font size set by `scale`. Defaults to `25`

height.description: Height of the printed label in `em`, relative to the font size set by `scale`. Defaults to `15`

scale.description: Font size of the printed label in millimetres. A larger value also makes the label wider and higher. Defaults to `4`

checked_in_template.description: HTML template displayed after a successful check-in. Supports the placeholders {{ title }}, {{ room_name }}, {{ host_name }}, {{ host_email }}, {{ visitor_name }}, {{ visitor_email }}, {{ can_use_lift }}, {{ date }} and {{ time }}

standalone_visitor_location.description: Location associated with standalone visitors (visitors without a linked calendar event). When set, standalone visitors are also offered beverage preferences after check-in

induction_enabled.description: Whether to show an induction acceptance step in the check-in and registration flows. Requires `induction_details` to also be set

induction_details.description: Induction text displayed to visitors for acceptance. The induction step is hidden when this is unset

induction_after_details.description: Whether the induction step is shown after the visitor details form instead of before it

visitors.description: Visitor booking settings. These override the matching `bookings` settings

allow_all_day.description: Whether the all-day option is available on the self-registration form. Overrides `bookings.allow_all_day`

max_duration.description: Maximum visit duration in minutes selectable on the self-registration form. Overrides `bookings.max_duration`. Defaults to `180`

bookings.description: General booking settings used as a fallback for the matching `visitors` settings

allow_all_day.description: Whether the all-day option is available on the self-registration form

max_duration.description: Maximum visit duration in minutes selectable on the self-registration form. Defaults to `180`

explore.description: Data associated with map rendering on the explore page

colors.description: Mapping of keys to their color values. Keys are usually in the format `<type>-<status>`

search_enabled.description: Whether to show the search bar on the explore page. The search bar is hidden when not set

show_legend.description: Whether to show the legend on the explore page. The legend is hidden only when set to `false`

show_booking_qr.description: Whether a room booking shows a QR code to book on a personal device, instead of the booking form

disable.description: Map layers to turn off: features, actions, labels and styles

disable_features.description: Map layers whose features are turned off

disable_actions.description: Map layers whose click actions are turned off

disable_labels.description: Map layers whose labels are turned off

disable_styles.description: Map layers whose styles are turned off

hide_device_fields.description: Fields to hide in device tooltips

use_zone_polygons.description: Whether to draw zone areas with their polygon data

show_zone_labels.description: Whether to show labels for zone areas

show_zone_sensor_info.description: Whether to show sensor values in zone area labels

area_count_key.description: Key of the zone area value to use as the people count. Defaults to `count`

desks.description: Desk settings for the explore page

enable_maps.description: Whether people can book desks from the map. On unless set to `false`

show_users.description: Whether desk tooltips show the name of the person at the desk. On unless set to `false`

use_24_hour_time.description: Whether to show times with a 24-hour clock

use_imperial_units.description: Whether zone sensor labels show temperatures in Fahrenheit

enabled.description: Whether to show the global chat widget. Off when not set

environment_bar.description: CSS colour for thin identifier bars at the top and bottom of the app. Leave unset to hide the bars

locales.description: List of locales available in the language selector on the welcome page. The selector is hidden when fewer than two locales are set

map_layers.description: Map layer names, such as `devices`, `desks`, `lockers`, `parking`, `spaces`, `spaces-presence` and `zones`

banner.description: Message banner shown at the top of the app. The user can close it

id.description: Unique ID for the banner. A closed banner stays hidden until the ID changes

type.description: Colour style for the banner. Defaults to `info`

content.description: Message text to show in the banner

name.description: Translation key for the locale's display name, e.g. `LANGUAGE.ENGLISH`

local.description: Name of the locale in its own language, e.g. `Français`

flag.description: Flag emoji displayed next to the locale name
